newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers reassigns ads in Asia/Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers reassigns ads in Asia/Pacific.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Thursday it has completed reassigning its consumer advertising in the Asia/Pacific region.

The company said it gave the Mead Johnson nutritional brands in Asia to D'Arcy Masius Benton & Bowles. Bozell Worldwide will handle Bristol-Myers personal care, over-the-counter medicines and skin care advertising in China, and Ogilvy & Mather Wire Plastics Products PLC will oversee personal care in Thailand and hair care and vitamins in China, the company said.

Earlier this year, the company assigned its Clairol Natural Instincts and Clairol brands in Europe to WRG-BDDP and gave Excedrin PM and Ban deodorant to Bozell, which also assumed responsibility for Mead Johnson brands in the United States with WRG-BDDP, the company said.
Zenith Media, a unit of Cordiant Plc, continues to handle media in Europe and takes on spot television in the U.S. and media in Australia and New Zealand, Bristol-Myers said.
D'Arcy Masius Benton & Bowles take on other media work in South East Asian markets, except for Thailand and China, where Ogilvy & Mather will handle the accounts, the company said.
